text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Together with Cesario, for the sake of the 
future. It was on a day when those three 
years of running together had reached a 
milestone.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Thinking about how I just couldn't shake 
off my sleepiness today, I sorted through 
paperwork, when—

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Trainer. Um...

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: "Could it be you aren't feeling well?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Now that you mention it... my head feels 
heavy, and I think I'm getting chills.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Taking a temperature reading as a check...

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: 37.4 degrees, is it?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
What are you saying? Today is a day off. 
Come on, let's head home.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, today turned into a day off.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Please make sure to stay in bed. Even if 
you can't sleep, just lying down makes a 
huge difference.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
"I'm going to step out to do some quick 
shopping. Is there anything you'd like to 
eat?"
choice_data_list: No, no, I'd really feel bad.
No, no, I'd feel bad taking that.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I can't risk passing it to anyone, and 
besides, I can manage something like this 
on my own.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Please just rest quietly and let me take 
care of you today.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
"...Unless there is someone else available 
to nurse you, that is."

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Fufu, I know.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Unable to refuse her persistence, I ended 
up letting her nurse me back to health—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps my body was more tired than I 
realized, because before I knew it, I had 
fallen asleep.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...―― I wake up to the rhythmic 
tap-tapping sound and a gentle, soft 
aroma."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
When I sat up, Cesario was right there in 
the kitchen, making soup for me.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Ah, are you awake?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
"What good timing. I just finished making 
it."
choice_data_list: So you made this for me?
You made this just for me?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
It tastes best when it's freshly made. Are 
you hungry?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Before I could answer, my stomach let out 
a loud rumble.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, thank goodness. Now then, please go 
wash your hands.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The soup served for me was warm, and 
soaked gently into my weakened body.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: You're welcome.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to Cesario, my body felt light. My 
head cleared up too— And then, a thought 
crossed my mind.
choice_data_list: You noticed I wasn't feeling well, huh?

You noticed I wasn't feeling well, didn't 
you?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
To think Cesario could understand things 
about me that even I hadn't noticed 
myself.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: ...Fufu, what are you talking about?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
After all, Trainer, you were the one who 
noticed what was going on with my legs, 
weren't you?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
That summer, when we were talking about 
going overseas. To the slight inflammation 
that even I had failed to notice.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: A given for a Trainer? Is that really so?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
I know full well that this was the result 
of an extraordinary amount of hard work.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: That's why I, too...

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
"I've always wanted to be that kind of 
person to you."

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
So today, a little dream of mine came 
true.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I'm sorry. Even though you're going 
through a tough time, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"If I hadn't noticed and gotten some rest 
today, my condition might have been even 
worse tomorrow."

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
"...Let's both take care of our health and 
stay in good spirits forever, okay?"

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
There is still a long road ahead, after 
all.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Nodding, you finish the soup. Come to 
think of it, the softly simmered 
vegetables were all among your favorites.
